title: デビュー戦の後に・サイコーの初陣！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: My debut race was HOTTER THAN HOT! Even though I ran at top speed, I still wanna push myself to be faster next time!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer and I have decided to spend my junior year on my very own training arc!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: First, I have to build up some real racing experience so we can figure out what kind of races suit me best!
